summary: Iteration 40: Social Router Refactor, Card UI Full-Width, Stripe Checkout - All 27 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Card view page displays full-width (1792px on 1920px screen), responsive on mobile (366px on 390px screen). Premium page shows 3 pricing cards with Suscribirse buttons. Stripe checkout redirect working - redirects to checkout.stripe.com with correct $4.99 amount. Feed sidebar shows Tendencias and Personas sugeridas sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Social router (routers/social.py) correctly handles all social endpoints with proper auth
Social router uses set_db pattern for database injection
Reactions endpoint POST /api/posts/{id}/react?reaction_type=like works with multiple reaction types
Polls endpoints POST /api/social/polls and GET /api/social/polls/{id} work correctly
Trending endpoint GET /api/social/trending returns hashtag list (fallback data if no posts)
Explore endpoint GET /api/social/explore returns posts with category filter support
Suggested users endpoint GET /api/social/suggested returns personalized suggestions
Blocked users endpoint GET /api/users/me/blocked returns blocked list
ViewCardPage removed max-w-5xl constraint - card container is 1792px on 1920px screen
ViewCardPage has bubble sections (contact, social, gallery) with data-testid attributes
ViewCardPage responsive on mobile - 366px container on 390px viewport
PremiumPage shows 3 packages: analytics_monthly ($4.99), analytics_yearly ($39.99), premium_monthly ($9.99)
Stripe checkout creates session and redirects to checkout.stripe.com
BeaconsStyleCard used for job-type cards in FeedPage with bubble layout
FeedSidebar shows Tendencias (trending hashtags) and Personas sugeridas (suggested users)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 verified social router refactor, card UI full-width layout, and Stripe checkout. Key findings: 1) All social endpoints moved to routers/social.py work correctly (follow, block, bookmark, react, polls, trending, explore, suggested). 2) ViewCardPage displays full-width on 1920px screens (1792px container width) - no max-w-5xl constraint. 3) ViewCardPage has bubble sections with data-testid attributes (card-contact-bubble, card-social-bubble, card-gallery-bubble). 4) ViewCardPage responsive on mobile (366px on 390px viewport). 5) Premium page shows 3 packages with checkout buttons. 6) Stripe checkout redirect working - redirects to checkout.stripe.com with correct amount. 7) Feed sidebar shows Tendencias and Personas sugeridas sections. 8) BeaconsStyleCard used for job-type cards in feed.
